text: EX-10.5 7 ea031252701ex10-5.htm FORM OF SHARE SALE AGREEMENT Exhibit 10.5 FORM OF SHARE SALE AGREEMENT This Share Sale Agreement (this “ Share Sale Agreement ”) is made and entered into as of [●], 202[●], being the Closing Date, by and among (i) Turquoise Advanced Materials, Inc. , a Delaware corporation (“ PubCo ”), as the surviving corporation of the Reincorporation and successor by merger to Stellar V Capital Corp. , a Cayman Islands exempted company (“ Acquiror” ), (ii) Turquoise Group Pty Ltd , an Australian proprietary company (the “Company” ), and (iii) the undersigned shareholder of the Company (“ Seller ” and, collectively with the other Company Shareholders who enter into a share sale agreement in substantially the form of this Share Sale Agreement or a joinder hereto, the “ Sellers ”). Any capitalized term used but not defined herein shall have the meaning given to such term in the BCA (as defined below). RECITALS WHEREAS , Acquiror, the Company, Stellar V Sponsor LLC, PubCo and the Sellers named on Annex I thereto entered into a Business Combination Agreement, dated as of November [●], 2026 (as amended from time to time in accordance with its terms, the “ BCA ”), pursuant to which, among other matters, (a) Acquiror has merged with and into PubCo, with PubCo continuing as the surviving corporation, (b) each Company Convertible Security has been converted, exercised or otherwise settled in accordance with Section 3.02 of the BCA, and (c) on the date hereof, being the Closing Date and at least one Business Day after the Reincorporation Effective Time, the Sellers are exchanging all of the issued and outstanding shares and any other equity interests in or of the Company for PubCo Common Shares (the “ Share Exchange ”), all upon the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in the BCA and in accordance with the Cayman Companies Act, the DGCL, the Australian Companies Act and other applicable Law; WHEREAS , Section 3.03 of the BCA provides that, on the Closing Date, the Company, the Company Shareholders and PubCo shall execute and deliver this Share Sale Agreement, pursuant to which the Company Shareholders shall be entitled to have issued to them by PubCo the Exchange Shares; and WHEREAS , as of the date hereof, Seller owns the number of Company Shares set forth on the signature page hereto. NOW, THEREFORE , in consideration of the representations, warranties, covenants and agreements contained in this Share Sale Agreement and the BCA, and intending to be legally bound hereby, the parties agree as follows: ARTICLE I SHARE EXCHANGE 1.1 Sale of Company Shares . At the Closing, and subject to and upon the terms and conditions of this Share Sale Agreement and the BCA, Seller shall sell, transfer, convey, assign and deliver to PubCo, and PubCo shall purchase, acquire and accept from Seller, all of the Company Shares owned by Seller, including any Company Shares issued to Seller prior to the Share Exchange upon the exercise of any option or the conversion of any Company Convertible Securities or upon the conversion of the Bridge Financing (or any alternative bridge or working capital funding) pursuant to the BCA, free and clear of all Liens (other than those imposed by applicable securities Laws and the Company’s Governing Documents or to be released by way of a Company Closing Deliverable). Delivery of Seller’s Company Shares shall be effected, and risk of loss and title to such Company Shares shall pass to PubCo, only upon delivery of the Closing Deliverables to PubCo, together with the instruments of transfer contemplated by Section 1.3 . 1.2 Consideration . The consideration for all of Seller’s Company Shares shall be (a) Seller’s Pro Rata Share of the Exchange Shares, and (b) Seller’s Pro Rata Share of the Company Earnout Shares issuable to the Sellers in accordance with Section 3.11 of the BCA, in each case as set forth opposite Seller’s name in the Equityholder Allocation Schedule and Seller shall have no right to any other consideration except as provided in Sections 3.07 and 3.11 of the BCA (to the extent applicable) in respect of Seller’s Company Shares. Seller agrees that PubCo shall be entitled to rely conclusively on the Equityholder Allocation Schedule in accordance with Section 3.07(b) of the BCA. 1.3 Surrender of Company Shares . At the Closing, Seller shall deliver to PubCo (a) the Closing Deliverables (including a duly executed share transfer form in respect of Seller’s Company Shares in registrable form under the Australian Companies Act and the Company Charter), and (b) such other documents as may reasonably be required by PubCo in accordance with Section 3.04 of the BCA. Seller hereby authorizes any director or secretary of the Company to update the register of members of the Company to record PubCo as the holder of Seller’s Company Shares to the extent necessary, and to make any notifications or filings required by applicable Law in relation thereto. In the event that any certificate representing Seller’s Company Shares has been lost, stolen, mutilated or destroyed, Seller may instead deliver an affidavit of that fact and, if required by PubCo, a customary indemnity against any claim that may be made against PubCo with respect to such Company Shares, in accordance with Section 3.05 of the BCA. 1.4 Fractional Shares . Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained herein, no fraction of a PubCo Common Share will be issued by PubCo by virtue of this Share Sale Agreement or the transactions contemplated hereby, and in the event that Seller would otherwise be entitled to a fraction of a PubCo Common Share (after aggregating all fractional PubCo Common Shares that would otherwise be received by Seller), Seller shall instead have the number of PubCo Common Shares issued to Seller rounded down in the aggregate to the nearest whole PubCo Common Share, in accordance with Section 3.03 of the BCA. 1.5 PubCo Governing Documents . Seller agrees to be a stockholder of PubCo and to take any and all PubCo Common Shares and PubCo Preferred Shares that Seller shall receive subject to the PubCo Charter, and Seller hereby authorizes PubCo to enter its name and address in the stock ledger of PubCo in respect of such shares. 1.6 Power of Attorney . Seller hereby irrevocably appoints PubCo and any director or secretary of the Company (each acting alone, and each with full power of substitution) as Seller’s attorney, which appointment is coupled with an interest and may be exercised at and after the Closing without any notice to or demand on Seller, to date, complete and deliver the share transfer forms and any other document referred to in Section 1.3, to update the register of members of the Company, and to execute any document necessary to vest title to Seller’s Company Shares in PubCo. ARTICLE II CLOSING 2.1 Closing . The Share Exchange is being consummated on the date hereof as part of the Closing, simultaneously with the execution and delivery of this Share Sale Agreement. Concurrently with the execution and delivery of this Share Sale Agreement, Seller is delivering the items set forth in Section 1.3 to PubCo, and PubCo shall issue the consideration under Section 1.2 in accordance with the requirements of the BCA. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, PubCo’s obligation to issue any consideration to any Seller is conditioned upon PubCo receiving all of the issued Company Shares (whether pursuant to share sale agreements or the BCA), which condition may be waived only by PubCo. Seller has executed and delivered, or is concurrently herewith executing and delivering, to PubCo (a) a Company Shareholder Lock-Up Agreement, and (b) the Registration Rights Agreement (such agreements, together with any other agreements, certificates and/or instruments that have been or are to be executed or delivered by Seller in connection with or pursuant to this Share Sale Agreement or the BCA, the “ Seller Ancillary Agreements ”). ARTICLE III REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES OF SELLER Seller hereby represents and warrants to PubCo as of the date hereof (being the Closing Date), as follows: 3.1 Organization and Capacity . If Seller is an entity, Seller is properly incorporated and validly existing under the Laws of Australia and has all requisite power, authority and legal right and capacity to execute, deliver and perform this Share Sale Agreement. If Seller is an individual, Seller has full legal capacity to execute, deliver and perform this Share Sale Agreement. Any individual executing this Share Sale Agreement on behalf of Seller is duly authorized to do so. 2 3.2 Authorization; Binding Agreement . Seller has all requisite power, authority and legal right and capacity to execute and deliver this Share Sale Agreement and each Seller Ancillary Agreement to which it is a party, to perform Seller’s obligations hereunder and thereunder and to consummate the Transactions. This Share Sale Agreement has been, and each Seller Ancillary Agreement to which Seller is or is required to be a party has been or shall be when delivered, duly and validly executed and delivered by Seller and, assuming the due authorization, execution and delivery of this Share Sale Agreement and any such Seller Ancillary Agreement by the other parties hereto and thereto, constitutes, or when delivered shall constitute, the legal, valid and binding obligation of Seller, enforceable against Seller in accordance with its terms, subject to applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, fraudulent conveyance, reorganization, moratorium and similar Laws affecting creditors’ rights generally and subject, as to enforceability, to general principles of equity. 3.3 No Insolvency Event . No Insolvency Event has occurred, or is threatened or reasonably likely to occur, in relation to Seller. 3.4 Ownership . Seller owns good, valid and marketable title to the Company Shares set forth underneath Seller’s name on the signature page hereto, free and clear of any and all Liens (other than those imposed by applicable securities Laws or the Company’s Governing Documents or to be released by way of a Company Closing Deliverable). There are no proxies, voting rights, shareholders’ agreements or other agreements or understandings, to which Seller is a party or by which Seller is bound, with respect to the voting or transfer of any of Seller’s Company Shares other than this Share Sale Agreement, the BCA, the Ancillary Agreements and the Company’s Governing Documents. Upon delivery of Seller’s Closing Deliverables to PubCo on the Closing Date in accordance with this Share Sale Agreement, the entire legal and beneficial interest in Seller’s Company Shares and good, valid and marketable title to Seller’s Company Shares, free and clear of all Liens (other than those imposed by applicable securities Laws or those incurred by PubCo or Acquiror or be released by way of a Company Closing Deliverable), will pass to PubCo. 3.5 Trustees . If Seller executes this Agreement in the capacity of a trustee (“Seller Trustee”), it represents and warrants that the relevant trust (“ Seller Trust ”) has been validly created and is in existence and is solely constituted by its relevant trust deed (“ Seller Trust Deed ”) and the Seller Trustee is not in breach of the relevant Seller Trustee and (i) that Seller Trust Deed is not void, voidable, otherwise unenforceable or; (ii) a date has not been declared under that Seller Trust Deed as the date on which that Seller Trust will be vested or come to an end; (iii) all duties and taxes properly payable on that Seller Trust Deed have been paid; (iv) the Seller Trustee has obtained all necessary authorizations and consents under the Seller Trust Deed and taken all other actions necessary to execute this Agreement. 3.6 Trustee Indemnity . Subject to clause 3.6(a) and (b). if Seller enters into this Agreement in the capacity of a Trustee, it has in its capacity as trustee of its Trust valid rights of indemnity against the assets of its Trust for all liabilities incurred by it in its capacity as trustee of its Trust (including those incurred by it under this agreement), which rights are not limited in any way (by set-off or otherwise) and those assets are available and sufficient for the satisfaction of all liabilities and other obligations incurred by a Trustee under this agreement. (a) Each Seller Trustee represents that, to the extent permitted by the Seller Trust Deed and applicable Law (including the Superannuation Industry (Supervision) Act 1993 (Cth)), (a) it has a right of indemnity out of the assets of the Seller Trust for liabilities properly incurred by it in its capacity as trustee, including under this Agreement; and (b) it has not done or omitted to do anything that would exclude, limit or impair that right (b) The liability of a Seller Trustee under or in connection with this Agreement is limited to the extent to which it is actually indemnified out of the assets of the Seller Trust. Acquiror and PubCo have no recourse to the Seller Trustee’s personal assets or to the assets of any other trust. This limit does not apply to the extent the liability arises from the Seller Trustee’s fraud or its breach of trust that disentitles it to the indemnity. 3 3.7 No Conflict . The execution, delivery and performance of this Share Sale Agreement by Seller and the consummation of the Transactions do not and will not (a) conflict with or violate any provision of, or result in the breach of, Seller’s Governing Documents (if Seller is an entity) or any trust deed under which Seller holds its Company Shares, the Company’s Governing Documents or any Governing Documents of any Subsidiaries of the Company, (b) conflict with or result in any violation of any provision of any Law or Governmental Order applicable to Seller or any of its properties or assets, (c) violate, conflict with, result in a breach of any provision of or the loss of any benefit under, constitute a default (or an event which, with notice or lapse of time or both, would constitute a default) under, or result in the termination or acceleration of, or a right of termination, cancellation, modification, acceleration or amendment under, accelerate the performance required by, or result in the acceleration or trigger of any payment, posting of collateral (or right to require the posting of collateral), time of payment, vesting or increase in the amount of any compensation or benefit payable pursuant to, any of the terms, conditions or provisions of any Contract to which Seller is a party or by which any of its assets or properties may be bound or affected or (d) result in the creation of any Lien upon any of the properties or assets of Seller, except (in the case of clauses (b), (c) or (d) above) for such violations, conflicts, breaches or defaults which would not, individually or in the aggregate, reasonably be expected to have a material adverse effect on the ability of Seller to enter into, perform its obligations under this Share Sale Agreement and consummate the Transactions. 3.8 Litigation. There is no Action pending or, to the knowledge of Seller, threatened, and no Governmental Order outstanding, against or involving Seller, whether at law or in equity, which would reasonably be expected to materially and adversely affect the ability of Seller to consummate the transactions contemplated by, and discharge its obligations under, this Share Sale Agreement, the BCA and the Seller Ancillary Agreements to which Seller is or is required to be a party. 3.9 Securities Acknowledgments . Seller acknowledges that: (a) Seller has received a copy of the Registration Statement and the prospectus included therein; (b) the Exchange Shares and the Company Earnout Shares are being issued pursuant to the Registration Statement; (c) if Seller is or becomes an affiliate of PubCo, resales of PubCo securities by Seller may be subject to limitations under Rule 144 and/or Rule 145 under the Securities Act; and (d) the PubCo securities received by Seller are subject to the restrictions on transfer set forth in the Company Shareholder Lock-Up Agreement. 3.10 Brokers . Subject to Schedule 4.13(g) of the BCA, no broker, finder, investment banker or other Person is entitled to any brokerage fee, finders’ fee or other commission payable by PubCo, Acquiror or the Company in connection with the Transactions based upon arrangements made by or on behalf of Seller. 3.11 No Other Representations . Except for the representations and warranties expressly made by Seller in this Article III, in Article V of the BCA or as expressly set forth in an Ancillary Agreement, neither Seller nor any other Person on its behalf makes any express or implied representation or warranty with respect to Seller or the Transactions, and Seller hereby expressly disclaims any other representations or warranties, whether implied or made by Seller or any of its Representatives. ARTICLE IV COVENANTS BY SELLER 4.1 Termination of Certain Agreements . Seller hereby agrees that, effective at the Closing, (a) any shareholders, voting or similar agreement among the Company and Seller or among Seller and the other Company Shareholders with respect to the Company’s securities, and (b) any registration rights agreement between the Company and its shareholders to which Seller is a party or bound, in each case of clauses (a) and (b), shall automatically, and without any further action by any of the parties hereto, insofar as Seller has any rights thereunder, terminate in full and become null and void and of no further force and effect. Further, Seller hereby waives any obligations of the Company under the Company’s Governing Documents or any agreement described in clause (a) or (b) above with respect to the transactions contemplated by this Share Sale Agreement and the BCA, and any failure of the parties to comply with the terms thereof in connection with the transactions contemplated by this Share Sale Agreement and the BCA. 4.2 No Trading . Seller acknowledges and agrees that it is aware, and that its Affiliates are aware (and each of their respective Representatives is aware or, upon receipt of any material nonpublic information of PubCo, will be advised) of the restrictions imposed by Securities Laws and other applicable foreign and domestic Laws on a Person possessing material nonpublic information about a publicly traded company. Seller hereby agrees that, while it is in possession of such material nonpublic information, it shall not purchase or sell any securities of PubCo, communicate such information to any third party, take any other action with respect to PubCo in violation of such Laws, or cause or encourage any third party to do any of the foregoing. 4 4.3 Efforts; Further Assurances . Following the Closing, Seller shall, on the request of PubCo or the Company, execute such further documents, and perform such further acts, as may be reasonably necessary or appropriate to give full effect to the transfer of Seller’s Company Shares to PubCo and the other transactions contemplated by this Share Sale Agreement, and to comply as promptly as practicable with all requirements of Governmental Authorities applicable thereto. Without limiting the foregoing, Seller will promptly provide to PubCo any information reasonably requested by or on behalf of PubCo regarding Seller for inclusion in any registration statement filed pursuant to the Registration Rights Agreement (including the resale registration statement) or any other filing with the SEC. 4.4 Release . Effective as of the Closing, Seller, on behalf of itself and its Affiliates, heirs, successors and assigns, hereby irrevocably, unconditionally and completely releases, acquits and forever discharges PubCo and Acquiror (as predecessor of PubCo), the Company, the Sponsor, and the directors and officers of Acquiror, and their respective past, present and future Subsidiaries, directors, officers, employees, successors and assigns, from any and all claims, demands, Actions, causes of action, obligations and liabilities of any kind, whether known or unknown, which Seller or any such Person now has, has ever had or may hereafter have against any such released person arising out of or related to Seller’s ownership of Company Shares or any other Company Securities at or prior to the Closing; provided , that nothing in this Section 4.4 shall release (a) any rights of Seller under this Share Sale Agreement, the BCA or any other Ancillary Agreement, including the right to receive the consideration set forth in Section 1.2 , (b) any rights to indemnification, exculpation or insurance coverage, including under Section 9.06 of the BCA, (c) any claim that cannot be released as a matter of applicable Law, (d) any amount owing by the Company Group to Seller or its Affiliates for loans, deferred bonuses, remuneration, employment or director entitlements or expense reimbursement, (e) any rights of Seller as a director, officer or employee. PubCo and the Company release Seller from all claims arising out of or related to Seller’s ownership of Company Shares, other than fraud. 4.5 Withholding; Transfer Taxes . PubCo and the Company shall be entitled to deduct and withhold from any consideration deliverable under this Share Sale Agreement such amounts as are required to be deducted and withheld under applicable Law, and the Sellers will each be required to provide a FRCGWCC (or equivalent declaration given under Section 3.06 of the BCA) to the Acquiror and PubCo prior to the Closing (which remains valid and in force as at the Effective Time), in each case subject to and in accordance with Section 3.06 of the BCA. Transfer Taxes in connection with the Share Exchange shall be borne and paid in accordance with Section 9.03(a) of the BCA. 4.6 Trust Account Waiver . Seller hereby agrees to be bound by Section 7.04 (No Claim Against the Trust Account) of the BCA, mutatis mutandis , as if Seller were the Company thereunder. ARTICLE V MISCELLANEOUS 5.1 Binding Agreement; Assignment . This Share Sale Agreement and all of the provisions hereof shall be binding upon the parties hereto, and their respective successors and permitted assigns. This Share Sale Agreement shall not be assigned by Seller by operation of law or otherwise without the prior written consent of the Company and PubCo, and any assignment without such consent shall be null and void; provided, that no such assignment shall relieve the assigning party of its obligations hereunder. 5.2 Governing Law; Jurisdiction . This Share Sale Agreement shall be governed by, construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of New York without regard to the conflict of laws principles thereof. Each party hereto hereby (a) submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of any state or federal court located in the County of New York in the State of New York (or in any appellate court thereof) (the “ Specified Courts ”) for the purpose of any claim, action, litigation or other legal proceeding arising out of or relating to this Share Sale Agreement or the transactions contemplated hereby (a “ Proceeding ”), and (b) irrevocably waives, and agrees not to assert by way of motion, defense or otherwise, in any such Proceeding, any claim that it is not subject personally to the jurisdiction of the above-named courts, that its property is exempt or immune from attachment or execution, that the Proceeding is brought in an inconvenient forum, that the venue of the Proceeding is improper, or that this Share Sale Agreement or the transactions contemplated hereby may not be enforced in or by any Specified Court. Each party agrees that a final judgment in any Proceeding shall be conclusive and may be enforced in other jurisdictions by suit on the judgment or in any other manner provided by law. Each party irrevocably consents to the service of the summons and complaint and any other process in any Proceeding, on behalf of itself, or its property, by personal delivery of copies of such process to such party its applicable address set forth in Section 5.8 . Each Seller that is not resident in the United States hereby irrevocably appoints [●], New York, New York, as its agent to receive service of process in any Proceeding. Nothing in this Section 5.2 shall affect the right of any party hereto to serve legal process in any other manner permitted by law. 5.3 Waiver of Jury Trial . Each party hereby waives to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law any right it may have to a trial by jury with respect to any Proceeding. Each party (a) certifies that no Representative of any other party has represented, expressly or otherwise, that such other party would not, in the event of any Proceeding, seek to enforce that foregoing waiver and (b) acknowledges that it and the other parties hereto have been induced to enter into this Share Sale Agreement by, among other things, the mutual waivers and certifications in this Section 5.3 . 5.4 Specific Performance . Each party acknowledges that the rights of each party to consummate the transactions contemplated hereby are unique, recognizes and affirms that in the event of a breach of this Share Sale Agreement by any party, money damages may be inadequate and the non-breaching parties may have no adequate remedy at law, and agree that irreparable damage would occur in the event that any of the provisions of this Share Sale Agreement were not performed by an applicable party in accordance with their specific terms or were otherwise breached. Accordingly, each party shall be entitled to seek an injunction or restraining order to prevent breaches of this Share Sale Agreement and to seek to enforce specifically the terms and provisions hereof, including the obligation to effect the transactions contemplated hereby, without the requirement to post any bond or other security or to prove that money damages would be inadequate, this being in addition to any other right or remedy to which such party may be entitled under this Share Sale Agreement, at law or in equity. 5 5.5 Severability . In case any provision in this Share Sale Agreement shall be held invalid, illegal or unenforceable in a jurisdiction, such provision shall be modified or deleted, as to the jurisdiction involved, only to the extent necessary to render the same valid, legal and enforceable, and the validity, legality and enforceability of the remaining provisions hereof shall not in any way be affected or impaired thereby nor shall the validity, legality or enforceability of such provision be affected thereby in any other jurisdiction. Upon such determination that any term or other provision is invalid, illegal or incapable of being enforced, the parties hereto will substitute for any invalid, illegal or unenforceable provision a suitable and equitable provision that carries out, so far as may be valid, legal and enforceable, the intent and purpose of such invalid, illegal or unenforceable provision. 5.6 Counterparts . This Share Sale Agreement may be executed and delivered (including by facsimile or other electronic transmission) in one or more counterparts, and by the different parties hereto in separate counterparts, each of which when executed shall be deemed to be an original but all of which taken together shall constitute one and the same agreement. 5.7 Interpretation . This Share Sale Agreement shall be construed and interpreted in a manner consistent with the BCA. Without limiting the foregoing, the provisions of Section 12.14 (Non-Recourse) of the BCA are hereby incorporated herein mutatis mutandis as if set forth herein, with any reference therein to “this Agreement” instead being a reference to this Share Sale Agreement, and with any reference to the “Parties” therein instead being a reference to the parties to this Share Sale Agreement. Any capitalized terms used but not defined herein shall have the meaning given to such term in the BCA. 5.8 Notices . All notices, consents, waivers and other communications hereunder shall be in writing and shall be deemed to have been duly given when delivered (i) in person, (ii) by email, with affirmative confirmation of receipt, (iii) one Business Day after being sent, if sent by reputable, nationally recognized overnight courier service, or (iv) three (3) Business Days after being mailed, if sent by registered or certified mail, pre-paid and return receipt requested, in each case to the applicable party at the following addresses (or at such other address as shall be specified by like notice): If to PubCo, to: Turquoise Advanced Materials, Inc. [__] Attn: [__] E-mail: [__] with a copy (which will not constitute notice) to: [__] Attn: [__] E-mail: [__] If to the Company, to: Turquoise Group Pty Ltd [__] Attn: [__] E-mail: [__] with a copy (which will not constitute notice) to: [__] Attn: [__] E-mail: [__] If to Seller, to: The address set forth underneath Seller’s name on the signature page hereto 5.9 Amendment; Waiver . This Share Sale Agreement may be amended, supplemented or modified only by execution of a written instrument signed by the parties hereto. The provisions of this Share Sale Agreement may only be waived in a writing signed by the party against whom enforcement of such waiver is sought. No failure or delay by a party in exercising any right hereunder shall operate as a waiver thereof nor shall any single or partial exercise thereof preclude any other or further exercise of any other right hereunder. 5.10 Entire Agreement; Successors . This Share Sale Agreement and the documents or instruments referred to herein (including the BCA to the extent incorporated or referenced herein), including any exhibits, annexes and schedules attached hereto, which exhibits, annexes and schedules are incorporated herein by reference, embody the entire agreement and understanding of the parties hereto in respect of the subject matter contained herein. There are no restrictions, promises, representations, warranties, covenants or undertakings, other than those expressly set forth or referred to herein or the documents or instruments referred to herein, which collectively supersede all prior agreements and the understandings among the parties with respect to the subject matter contained herein. 5.11 Third Party Beneficiaries . Nothing contained in this Share Sale Agreement or in any instrument or document executed by any party in connection with the transactions contemplated hereby shall create any rights in, or be deemed to have been executed for the benefit of, any Person that is not a party hereto or thereto or a successor or permitted assign of such a party; provided , that the Persons released under Section 4.4 are intended third-party beneficiaries of Section 4.4 and shall be entitled to enforce it. 5.12 Survival . The representations and warranties of Seller set forth in Section 3.1 (Organization and Capacity), Section 3.2 (Authorization; Binding Agreement) and Section 3.3 (Ownership) shall survive the Closing for the applicable statute of limitations; all other representations and warranties in this Share Sale Agreement shall not survive the Closing. The covenants and agreements made by Seller, the Company and PubCo in this Share Sale Agreement or in any certificate or instrument delivered pursuant to this Share Sale Agreement, including any rights arising out of any breach of such covenants or agreements, shall not survive the Closing, except for those covenants and agreements contained herein that by their terms apply or are to be performed in whole or in part after the Closing (which such covenants shall survive the Closing and continue until fully performed in accordance with their terms). {Remainder of Page Intentionally Left Blank; Signature Page Follows} 6 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereto have executed this Share Sale Agreement as of the date first written above. text: EX-10.1 2 mdln-ex10_1.htm EX-10.1 EX-10.1 Exhibit 10.1 SHARE AND UNIT REPURCHASE AGREEMENT THIS SHARE AND UNIT REPURCHASE AGREEMENT (this “ Agreement ”) is made and entered into as of November 16, 2026, by and among Medline Inc., a Delaware corporation (“ Medline ”), Medline Holdings, LP, a Delaware limited partnership (“ Medline Holdings ” and, together with Medline, the “ Medline Parties , ” and each a “ Medline Party ”), and the selling stockholders (the “ Selling Stockholders ”) and the selling unitholders (the “ Selling Unitholders ” and together with the Selling Stockholders, the “ Sellers, ” and each a “ Seller ”) set forth on Schedule I hereto. WHEREAS, the Selling Stockholders own shares (the “ Shares ”) of Class A common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, of Medline (the “ Class A Common Stock ”) and the Selling Unitholders own shares of Class B common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, of Medline (the “ Class B Common Stock ”) and limited partnership interests in Medline Holdings that constitute Common Units under the Holdings LPA (as defined below) (the “ Units ” and, together with the Shares, the “ Equity Interests ”); WHEREAS, Medline, Medline Holdings and the Sellers propose to enter into a transaction (the “ Repurchase Transaction ”) whereby (i) the Selling Stockholders shall sell to Medline and Medline shall purchase from the Selling Stockholders a number of whole Shares (the Shares to be sold to Medline, the “ Repurchase Class A Shares ”) and (ii) the Selling Unitholders shall sell to Medline Holdings and Medline Holdings shall purchase from the Selling Unitholders a number of whole Units such that the aggregate number of Equity Interests (collectively, the “ Repurchase Equity Interests ”) purchased by Medline and Medline Holdings is equal to the quotient of (x) $200,000,000 divided by (y) the per share price at which the Secondary Shares (as defined below) are sold to the underwriter(s) in the Secondary Offering (as defined below) (the “ Per Equity Interest Price ”), and rounded down to avoid fractional shares/units and subject to reduction under Schedule I , Section 1.7 or Section 5.1 ; WHEREAS, the Repurchase Equity Interests shall be sold by the Sellers and purchased by the Medline Parties at a price per Repurchase Equity Interest equal to the Per Equity Interest Price; WHEREAS, the Sellers propose to sell through an underwritten public offering registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “ SEC ”) certain other Shares (the “ Secondary Shares ”) owned by the Sellers (the “ Secondary Offering ”); WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 2.04 of the amended and restated organization agreement (the “ Organization Agreement ”), dated as of December 16, 2025, by and between Medline and Medline Holdings, effective simultaneously with the settlement of a repurchase of a share of Class A Common Stock by Medline for cash, Medline Holdings shall repurchase one Unit held by Medline (or, if designated by Medline, any of Medline’s subsidiaries holding Units) in exchange for an amount of cash equal to the applicable Gross Cash Amount (as defined in the Organization Agreement); WHEREAS, Medline is the general partner of Medline Holdings; and WHEREAS, after due consideration, the audit committee of the board of directors of Medline has approved the Repurchase Transaction. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing, of the mutual promises herein set forth, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, it is hereby agreed as follows: ARTICLE I REPURCHASE Section 1.1 Repurchase of Equity Interests . Each Seller shall, severally and not jointly, to the extent it agrees to sell any Shares in the Secondary Offering, sell to the applicable Medline Party (Medline, in the case of Repurchase Class A Shares, and Medline Holdings, in the case of Units, unless Medline designates otherwise under Section 5.6(a) ), and the applicable Medline Party shall purchase from such Seller that number of Repurchase Equity Interests set forth for such Seller in the Closing Calculation Schedule (as defined below), under the terms and subject to the conditions hereof and in reliance upon the representations, warranties and agreements contained herein, at the Closing (as defined below), at a price per Repurchase Equity Interest equal to the Per Equity Interest Price. For the avoidance of doubt, the Per Equity Interest Price shall equal the per share proceeds, before expenses, to the Sellers listed on the cover of the final prospectus supplement in the Secondary Offering. Section 1.2 Closing . (a) The closing (the “ Closing ”) of the Repurchase Transaction shall be immediately subsequent to the satisfaction or waiver of the conditions set forth in Article IV herein (with the date upon which such satisfaction or waiver occurs being referred to here as the “ Closing Date ”) or at such other time, date or place as the Sellers and the Medline Parties may agree in writing. (b) At the Closing, each Seller shall deliver or cause to be delivered the number of Repurchase Equity Interests sold by such Seller to the applicable Medline Party by an appropriate method reasonably agreed to by the Medline Parties and the Sellers, together with all customary documentation reasonably necessary to transfer to the applicable Medline Party the right, title and interest in and to such Repurchase Equity Interests and requested from the Seller at least two (2) days prior to the Closing, and the applicable Medline Party agrees to deliver to such Seller an amount in cash equal to the product of (x) the Per Equity Interest Price multiplied by (y) the number of Repurchase Equity Interests sold by such Seller under this Agreement by wire transfer of immediately available funds. (c) Effective simultaneously with the Closing, as contemplated by Section 2.04 of the Organization Agreement, to the extent applicable, for each Repurchase Class A Share purchased by Medline from the Selling Stockholders, Medline Holdings shall repurchase one Unit held by Medline (or, if designated by Medline, any of Medline’s subsidiaries holding Units) in exchange for an amount of cash equal to the applicable Gross Cash Amount. 2 Section 1.3 Transfer of Class B Shares; Cancellation . Upon the Closing, as permitted by Section 4.3(D)(2) of the Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation of Medline, a number of shares of Class B Common Stock held by each Selling Unitholder equal to the number of Units sold by such Selling Unitholder (the “ Class B Shares ”) shall be automatically transferred to Medline for no consideration. Each Selling Unitholder shall deliver to Medline at the Closing any customary instrument that Medline or its transfer agent reasonably requests at least two (2) days prior to the Closing to record the transfer of its Class B Shares. Upon the Closing, (a) Medline shall cancel and retire the Class B Shares and (b) Medline Holdings shall cancel and retire any Units it purchases under this Agreement. Section 1.4 Closing Calculation Schedule . Promptly following the pricing of the Secondary Offering, and in any event not later than two (2) Business Days prior to the Closing Date, Medline shall deliver to each Seller a schedule (the “ Closing Calculation Schedule ”) setting forth (a) the Per Equity Interest Price, (b) the aggregate number of Repurchase Equity Interests, (c) the number of Repurchase Equity Interests to be sold by each Seller, determined in accordance with Schedule I , (d) the number of Class B Shares, if applicable, to be transferred by each Seller, determined in accordance with Section 1.3 , and (e) the amount payable to each Seller at the Closing. Medline will consider in good faith any reasonable changes to the Closing Calculation Schedule as may be requested by any Seller at least one (1) Business Day prior to the Closing. The Closing Calculation Schedule shall be final and binding on the parties absent gross negligence or manifest error. Section 1.5 Consent; Waivers . Medline, in its capacity as the general partner of Medline Holdings, hereby consents to the sale, transfer, cancellation and retirement of the Units and the Class B Shares as contemplated by this Agreement. Effective as of the Closing, each Medline Party and each Seller hereby waives, on behalf of itself and, to the extent it has the right to do so, its affiliates, solely with respect to the transactions contemplated by this Agreement, any restriction on transfer, notice requirement, right of first refusal or first offer, tag-along or similar right, and any exchange, redemption or other procedural requirement or condition, that would otherwise apply to such transactions under (a) the Second Amended and Restated Limited Partnership Agreement of Medline Holdings, LP, dated December 16, 2025 (as amended, the “ Holdings LPA ”) and (b) the Exchange Agreement, dated December 16, 2025, by and among Medline, Medline Holdings and the holders of Units party thereto (as amended, the “ Exchange Agreement ”). Medline, in its capacity as the general partner of Medline Holdings, also waives, under Section 8.5 of the Holdings LPA, the requirement of Section 5.4(f) of the Holdings LPA that a holder transferring Common Units (as defined in the Holdings LPA) transfer an equal number of shares of Class B Common Stock to the same transferee, solely with respect to the sale of the Units to Medline Holdings and the transfer of the Class B Shares to Medline under this Agreement. The foregoing consent and waivers are limited to the transactions contemplated by this Agreement and shall not otherwise amend or waive any provision of such agreements. 3 Section 1.6 Withholding; Tax Forms . Before the Closing, each Selling Stockholder shall deliver to Medline a properly completed and duly executed Internal Revenue Service Form W-9 or applicable Internal Revenue Service Form W-8 (together with any required attachments), and each Selling Unitholder shall deliver to Medline a properly completed and duly executed Internal Revenue Service Form W-9. Each Medline Party and any other applicable withholding agent shall be entitled to deduct and withhold from any amount otherwise payable pursuant to this Agreement such amounts as are required to be deducted and withheld under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, or any other applicable Law. Any amounts so deducted and withheld shall be treated for all purposes of this Agreement as having been paid to the Seller in respect of which such deduction and withholding was made. The Medline Parties will cooperate with the Sellers to mitigate, reduce or eliminate any such deduction or withholding to the extent permitted under applicable Law, including by providing the Sellers with a reasonable opportunity to provide forms or other evidence that would reduce or eliminate such deduction or withholding before remitting any such withheld amounts to the applicable taxing authority. Section 1.7 Seller Default . If any Seller fails to deliver, or cause to be delivered, at or before the Closing any instrument, tax form or other document required to be delivered by it under Section 1.2(b), Section 1.3 or Section 1.6 (any such Seller, a “ Defaulting Seller ”), Medline may, in its sole discretion, elect to proceed with the Closing with all Sellers or solely with respect to the Sellers that are not Defaulting Sellers, in which latter case the Defaulting Seller’s Repurchase Equity Interests shall be reallocated among the other Sellers on a pro rata basis in proportion to the number of Repurchase Equity Interests to be sold by each Seller as set forth in the Closing Calculation Schedule, provided, that the other Sellers and the Medline Parties consent to any such reallocation. The rights and obligations of the Sellers hereunder are several and not joint, and no Seller shall be liable for any default by any other Seller. Nothing in this Section 1.7 shall relieve any Defaulting Seller of liability for its failure to perform its obligations hereunder. ARTICLE II REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES OF THE SELLERS Each of the Sellers severally and not jointly represents and warrants to the Medline Parties as follows: Section 2.1 Title to Repurchase Equity Interests and Class B Shares . Such Seller will have, immediately prior to the Closing, good and valid title to the Repurchase Equity Interests, including the Class B Shares where applicable, to be sold or transferred at the Closing Date by such Seller, free and clear of all liens, encumbrances, equities or adverse claims (other than pursuant to securities laws or agreements with the Medline Parties); and, upon delivery of such Repurchase Equity Interests, including the Class B Shares where applicable, and payment therefor pursuant hereto, good and valid title to such Repurchase Equity Interests, 4 including the Class B Shares where applicable, free and clear of all liens, encumbrances, equities or adverse claims (other than pursuant to securities laws or agreements with the Medline Parties), will pass to the applicable Medline Party or, in the case of the Class B Shares, to Medline. Section 2.2 Required Consents; Authority . Except as would not impair in any material respect the ability of such Seller to consummate its obligations hereunder, all consents, approvals, authorizations and orders necessary for the execution and delivery by such Seller of this Agreement, and for the sale and delivery of the Repurchase Equity Interests, including the Class B Shares where applicable, to be sold or transferred by such Seller hereunder, have been obtained; and such Seller has full right, power and authority to enter into this Agreement and to sell, assign, transfer and deliver the Repurchase Equity Interests, including the Class B Shares where applicable, to be sold or transferred by such Seller hereunder; this Agreement has been duly authorized, executed and delivered by or on behalf of such Seller. Section 2.3 Receipt of Information . Such Seller has received all the information it considers necessary or appropriate for deciding whether to consummate the Repurchase Transaction. Such Seller has had an opportunity to ask questions and receive answers from the Medline Parties. Such Seller has had the opportunity to discuss with its tax advisors the consequences of the Repurchase Transaction. Such Seller has not received, nor is it relying on, any representations or warranties from the Medline Parties other than as provided herein, and the Medline Parties hereby disclaim any other express or implied representations or warranties with respect to itself. ARTICLE III REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES OF THE MEDLINE PARTIES Each Medline Party severally and not jointly represents and warrants to the Sellers as follows: Section 3.1 Authority Relative to this Agreement . Except as would not impair in any material respect the ability of any Medline Party to consummate its obligations hereunder, each Medline Party has the power and authority to execute and deliver this Agreement and to perform its obligations hereunder; and all action required to be taken for the due and proper authorization, execution and delivery by it of this Agreement and the consummation by it of the transactions contemplated hereby has been duly and validly taken. Section 3.2 Approvals . Except as would not impair in any material respect the ability of any Medline Party to consummate its obligations hereunder, no consent, approval, authorization, order, license, registration or qualification of or with any court or arbitrator or governmental or regulatory authority is required for the execution, delivery and performance by each Medline Party of this Agreement and the consummation of the transactions contemplated by this Agreement. 5 Section 3.3 Delivery of Information . The Medline Parties have provided all the information they consider necessary or appropriate to the Sellers for deciding whether to consummate the Repurchase Transaction. The Medline Parties have not received, nor are they relying on, any representations or warranties from the Sellers other than as provided herein, and each Seller hereby disclaims any other express or implied representations or warranties with respect to itself. ARTICLE IV CONDITIONS TO CLOSING Section 4.1 Conditions to Obligations of the Medline Parties . The obligations of the Medline Parties to purchase the Repurchase Equity Interests from any applicable Seller and accept any applicable Class B Shares at the Closing are subject to the fulfillment on or prior to the Closing of each of the following conditions: (a) the Secondary Offering shall have been consummated in accordance with the terms and conditions of any underwriting agreement entered into in connection therewith; (b) the representations and warranties of such Seller set forth in Article II shall be true and correct in all material respects as of the Closing Date as though made on and as of the Closing Date; (c) such Seller shall have performed in all material respects all covenants and agreements required to be performed by it hereunder at or prior to the Closing; and (d) no Law or order of any court or other governmental authority of competent jurisdiction shall be in effect that restrains, enjoins, prohibits or makes illegal the consummation of the Repurchase Transaction with respect to such Seller or, if applicable, the transfer of any Class B Shares by such Seller. Notwithstanding the foregoing, each party shall use its reasonable best efforts to promptly consummate the Repurchase Transaction. ARTICLE V MISCELLANEOUS Section 5.1 Termination . This Agreement may be terminated at any time by the mutual written consent of each of the parties hereto. This Agreement may also be terminated solely as to any Seller by the mutual written consent of the Medline Parties and such Seller, in which case (i) this Agreement shall remain in full force and effect as to each other Seller, (ii) the Repurchase Equity Interests shall be reallocated to the other Sellers in accordance with Section 1.7, (iii) no such termination shall relieve such Seller of liability for any breach of this Agreement occurring prior to such termination and (iv) the provisions of this Article V shall survive such termination as to such Seller. Furthermore, unless such date is extended by the mutual written consent of each of the parties hereto, this Agreement shall automatically terminate and be of no further force and effect in the event that (a) the commencement of the Secondary Offering has not been publicly announced within eight (8) Business Days after the date hereof or (b) the conditions in Section 4.1 of this Agreement have not been satisfied within fifteen (15) Business Days after the date hereof. In the event of any termination of this 6 Agreement in its entirety, this Agreement shall forthwith become void and of no further force or effect, and there shall be no liability on the part of any party hereto, except that (a) the provisions of this Article V shall survive any such termination and (b) no such termination shall relieve any party of liability for any breach of this Agreement occurring prior to such termination. Section 5.2 Savings Clause . No provision of this Agreement shall be construed to require any party or its affiliates to take any action that would violate any applicable law (whether statutory or common), rule or regulation. Section 5.3 Amendment and Waiver . This Agreement may not be amended except by an instrument in writing signed on behalf of each of the parties hereto; provided, that any amendment that (x) solely affects only one Seller (and does not adversely affect the rights or obligations of any other Seller and is not inconsistent with the terms of this Agreement), and (y) does not increase the number of Equity Interests to be repurchased from, or the price to be paid to, such amending Seller, may be effected by an instrument in writing signed by the Medline Parties and such Seller, provided, further, that any such amendment shall be disclosed to each other Seller. Any party may waive in whole or in part any benefit or right provided to it under this Agreement, such waiver being effective only if contained in a writing executed by such party (and by the Medline Parties, in the case of any waiver by any Seller). The failure of any party to enforce any of the provisions of this Agreement shall in no way be construed as a waiver of such provisions and shall not affect the right of such party thereafter to enforce each and every provision of this Agreement in accordance with its terms. Section 5.4 Severability . If any provision of this Agreement shall be declared by any court of competent jurisdiction to be illegal, void or unenforceable, all other provisions of this Agreement shall not be affected and shall remain in full force and effect. Section 5.5 Entire Agreement . Except as otherwise expressly set forth herein, this Agreement, together with the several agreements and other documents and instruments referred to herein or therein or annexed hereto and executed contemporaneously herewith, embody the complete agreement and understanding among the parties hereto with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersede and preempt any prior understandings, agreements or representations by or among the parties, written or oral, that may have related to the subject matter hereof in any way. Nothing in this Agreement shall amend, modify or supersede any provision of the Exchange Agreement, the Registration Rights Agreement (as defined in Section 5.13 ), the Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation of Medline, the Holdings LPA or the Tax Receivable Agreement dated December 16, 2025, by and among Medline and the other parties thereto, except for the consent and waivers expressly set forth in Section 1.5 , and each such agreement shall otherwise remain in full force and effect in accordance with its terms. Section 5.6 Successors and Assigns . Neither this Agreement nor any of the rights or obligations of any party under this Agreement shall be assigned, in 7 whole or in part by any party without the prior written consent of the other parties. Notwithstanding the foregoing, (a) Medline may, by written notice to the Sellers delivered on or prior to the Closing Date, designate which Medline Party shall purchase any Repurchase Equity Interests hereunder, provided that such designation does not adversely affect any Seller, and (b) each Medline Party may, without the consent of any Seller, assign any or all of its rights or obligations hereunder to one or more of its affiliates, provided that no such assignment shall relieve the assigning party of its obligations hereunder, except to the extent actually performed by such applicable assignee or adversely affect any Seller. Section 5.7 No Third Party Beneficiaries . No Person other than the parties hereto shall have any rights or benefits under this Agreement, and nothing in this Agreement is intended to, or will, confer on any Person other than the parties hereto any rights, benefits or remedies. Section 5.8 No Broker . Except as previously disclosed to each other party in writing, no party has engaged any third party as broker or finder or incurred or become obligated to pay any broker’s commission or finder’s fee in connection with the transactions contemplated by this Agreement. Section 5.9 Counterparts . This Agreement and any amendment hereto may be executed in any number of counterparts (including counterparts transmitted electronically in portable document format (pdf), or any electronic signature complying with the U.S. federal ESIGN Act of 2000, e.g., www.docusign.com) with the same effect as if the signatures to each counterpart were upon a single instrument, all of which will be an original and together shall constitute a single instrument. The parties hereto irrevocably and unreservedly agree that this Agreement may be executed by way of electronic signatures and the parties agree that this Agreement, or any part thereof, shall not be challenged or denied any legal effect, validity and/or enforceability solely on the ground that it is in the form of an electronic record. Section 5.10 Notices . Any notice provided for in this Agreement shall be in writing and shall be either delivered electronically, personally delivered or sent by reputable overnight courier service (charges prepaid) to the address and to the attention of the person set forth in Schedule II hereto. Notices will be deemed to have been given hereunder when delivered personally or by e-mail (if no “bounceback” or similar error message is received), and two business days after deposit postage prepaid with a reputable overnight courier service for delivery on the next business day. Section 5.11 Governing Law; Waiver of Jury Trial . This Agreement and any claim, controversy or dispute arising under or related to this Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York applicable to agreements made and to be performed in such state. Notwithstanding the foregoing, (a) the transfer, cancellation and retirement of the Class B Shares and any other matter governed by the Delaware General Corporation Law or otherwise relating to the internal affairs of Medline, and (b) the transfer, cancellation and retirement of the Units and any other matter 8 governed by the Holdings LPA or the Delaware Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act, shall in each case be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware. Each party waives jury trial. Section 5.12 Interpretation . The headings contained in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not affect in any way the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement. The words “hereof,” “herein” and “hereunder” and words of similar import when used in this Agreement shall refer to this Agreement as a whole and not to any particular provision of this Agreement, and Article and Section references are to this Agreement unless otherwise specified. The meanings given to terms defined herein shall be equally applicable to both the singular and plural forms of such terms. Whenever the words “include,” “includes” or “including” are used in this Agreement, they shall be deemed to be followed by the words “without limitation.” “ Business Day ” means any day other than a Saturday, a Sunday, or a holiday on which national banking associations in the State of New York, the State of Illinois or the State of California are authorized by Law to close. “ Law ” means any statute, law, ordinance, rule or regulation of any governmental authority. “ Person ” means any individual, corporation, partnership, limited liability company, trust, association, governmental authority or other entity. Section 5.13 Expenses . Except to the extent provided in the Registration Rights Agreement dated as of December 16, 2025, by and among Medline, and the other parties thereto (the “ Registration Rights Agreement ”), each party shall bear its own costs and expenses (including legal, accounting and advisory fees) incurred in connection with this Agreement and the Repurchase Transaction. Without limiting the foregoing, no underwriting discount, commission, fee or expense reimbursement shall be payable by Medline or Medline Holdings in respect of the Repurchase Equity Interests or the Class B Shares, whether to the underwriters of the Secondary Offering or otherwise. Section 5.14 Confidentiality; Cooperation . Each Seller shall, and shall cause its affiliates and representatives to, keep the existence and terms of this Agreement and the Repurchase Transaction confidential until the commencement of the Secondary Offering has been publicly announced, except as may be required by applicable Law or the rules of any securities exchange. Each Seller hereby consents to (a) the disclosure of this Agreement and the Repurchase Transaction (including the identity of the Sellers and the terms hereof) in the registration statement, prospectus supplement and other offering materials for the Secondary Offering and in any report, schedule or other filing made by or on behalf of either Medline Party with the SEC or any securities exchange, including the filing of this Agreement as an exhibit thereto, and (b) the delivery of a copy of this Agreement to the underwriters of the Secondary Offering and their counsel. Section 5.15 Survival . The representations and warranties of the Parties hereunder shall not survive the Closing and shall terminate and expire at the Closing. 9 Section 5.16 Information Protections . Section 4.16 of the Registration Rights Agreement and Annex A attached thereto, are incorporated herein mutatis mutandis , except that nothing incorporated by this Section 5.16 shall limit any Seller’s obligations under Section 1.6 or the deduction and withholding rights of the Medline Parties and other withholding agents under Section 1.6 .
